entities.name: Dennick Betzold
entities.description: A human soldier of Gavony, illegitimate son of Bishop Worrin Betzold, who became a protective spirit soldier.

entities.name: Worrin Betzold
entities.description: A bishop and Dennick's father, who became a zombie during the Travails.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker who searched for the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Found an old book tracing the Key to the Betzold family.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: Knew Worrin Betzold and searched for the Key.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Dropped a zombie army among the ruins of Thraben.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire who was given the Key to protect it.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: Region of Innistrad where Dennick's family lived.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Ruined city searched by the group.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Where the Key would now be.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: Event that wiped out every trace of the Betzold name.

events.summary: Worrin gives Dennick a shield on his birthday; the next day the Travails begin and the Betzold name is wiped out.
events.quote: The next day, The Travails began, and every trace of the Betzold name was wiped out

events.summary: Kaya finds an old book showing the Key was given to an ancestor of the Betzold family.
events.quote: Kaya finds an old book showing that the Key was given to an ancestor of the Betzold family by a warlock

events.summary: Arlinn and Adeline find Bishop Worrin Betzold among the zombie army, now a zombie, and get the name Dennick from him.
events.quote: Arlinn and her companions manage to get the name Dennick from the bishop

events.summary: At the ruined Betzold mansion the group meets Dennick's spirit, who says his great-grandfather gave the Key to Sorin Markov.
events.quote: his great-grandfather gave the Key to the vampire Sorin Markov

relations.note: gave her information about the Key
relations.quote: they encounter the spirit of Dennick
